title: Good size pan with glass lid
text:
Good size pan with glass lid. Cute 11in. pan with the chili design all over the outside of the pan, and comes
With a glass lid with one small steam hole.
It’s nice to get a lid that fits your pan.

The pan cooks even on my gas stove. It’s non-stick.
I don’t consider this pan to be a granite stone type of inside as it’s too Smooth,
It just has the look, but it not granite stone cookware ,as I have two granite
Pans. And I do not think they where more money then this one also, and there
is no comparison.

The size of this pan is very useful, and with the sides being higher It keeps
The food inside the pan, then the stove top.
This pan will last you longer if it not in the dishwasher.
The medal Handle is very uncomfortable for me.
